keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «집에 돌아가려고 하자 거울에 금이 가기 시작했다(문제)» 와 «그날부터 루시는 거울 속 친구처럼 더 용감해졌다(변화)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (when Lucy tried to go home, the mirror began to crack) and the change (from that day on, Lucy was braver, just like her mirror friend). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: The mirror began to crack, and Lucy could get stuck.
Lucy became braver, like her mirror friend.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

opts: The mirror was cracking, and Lucy could get stuck.
It was time for dinner in the mirror world.
Lucy was late for a game.
evs: But when she tried to go home, the mirror began to crack!
People walked backward, clocks ran backward, and the sun was green.
Lucy found an old mirror in her grandmother's attic.
why: 루시가 집에 가려고 하자 거울에 금이 가기 시작했어요. 거울이 깨지면 루시가 영원히 갇히니까 서두르라고 한 거예요. 저녁 시간이나 놀이 이야기는 없어요.
When Lucy tried to go home, the mirror began to crack. If it broke, Lucy would be stuck forever, so Ycul told her to hurry. Nothing says it was dinner time or game time.

qs.q: The story says, "People walked backward, clocks ran backward." What does "backward" mean here?
qs.qko: "People walked backward, clocks ran backward."라는 말이 있어요. 여기서 "backward"는 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: "Everything here is opposite," Ycul said. "I am brave, but you are shy."
She met a girl named Ycul who looked just like her.
She landed in the attic just as the mirror broke.
why: 이쿨은 «여기선 모든 게 반대야»라고 말했어요. 사람도 시계도 보통과 반대 방향으로 움직였다는 뜻이에요.
Ycul said, «Everything here is opposite.» People and clocks moved in the opposite direction from normal.

opts: She remembered Ycul's words and jumped through the cracking mirror.
Her grandmother gave her a new mirror.
She stayed in the mirror world forever.
evs: Lucy was scared, but she remembered Ycul's words.
People walked backward, clocks ran backward, and the sun was green.
She took a deep breath and jumped through the glass.
When she touched it, her hand went through the glass!
why: 루시는 무서웠지만 이쿨의 말을 떠올렸고, 숨을 크게 들이쉬고 거울 속으로 뛰어들었어요. 두 문장을 이으면, 무서움을 이겨 낸 경험이 루시를 용감하게 만들었어요.
Lucy was scared, but she remembered Ycul's words, took a deep breath and jumped through the glass. Put these two sentences together: facing her fear made her brave.

ends: Lucy finds a new mirror and visits Ycul again.
루시가 새 거울을 찾아 이쿨을 다시 만나러 가요.
Brave Lucy sings a song in front of the whole school.
용감해진 루시가 전교생 앞에서 노래를 불러요.

write.src: “I can’t <u>stop feeling scared</u>, but I can <u>take a deep breath and try</u>.”

write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you can't do and what you can do instead in English.

img.cover: In a dusty attic, a nine-year-old girl with long brown hair in two braids, freckles, a blue dress and white sneakers leaps out of a tall old mirror with a wooden frame as thin cracks spread across the glass, while inside the mirror a nine-year-old girl who looks exactly like her, with long brown hair in two braids, freckles, a red dress and white sneakers cheers her on with both fists in the air.

scenes.1: In a strange bright town under a green sun, people walk backward along the street and a big round clock with no numbers has hands turning the wrong way, as a nine-year-old girl with long brown hair in two braids, freckles, a blue dress and white sneakers meets a nine-year-old girl who looks exactly like her, with long brown hair in two braids, freckles, a red dress and white sneakers and they stare at each other in surprise.
scenes.2: In the mirror world under a green sun, a nine-year-old girl who looks exactly like her, with long brown hair in two braids, freckles, a red dress and white sneakers pulls a nine-year-old girl with long brown hair in two braids, freckles, a blue dress and white sneakers by the hand as they run toward a tall old mirror with a wooden frame that has thin cracks spreading across its glass.

alt.1: A girl meets her mirror twin in a backward world with a green sun.
alt.2: The two girls run toward the cracking mirror.
alt.cover: A girl jumps out of a cracking mirror as her mirror twin cheers.
